title: Checkride Weak-Area Repeat Rate
dataSources: Flight logs (`flight:log`), flight-plan snapshots (`simbrief:plan`), network sessions (`vatsim:session`), prep tasks (`checkride:prep`), export syncs (`flight:export`).
app: Aviation and flight-sim telemetry — ForeFlight exports, SimBrief flight plans, VATSIM session logs, and checkride-prep trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=checkride:prep topic=* repeated_miss=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(repeated_miss="yes",1,0))) as matched by topic
| eval a_repeated_miss_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_repeated_miss_pct
description: Measures the percentage of mock-checkride drills that end with a repeated miss by checkride topic.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which checkride topic are helping or hurting mock-checkride drills.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a repeated miss` on `checkride:prep` events and summarize the hit rate by `topic`.
visualization: Table of checkride topic with percentage of mock-checkride drills ending with a repeated miss.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how often a repeated miss happens for each checkride topic so you can see where mock-checkride drills go smoothly or get stuck.
